_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. discord.com declares its design-token layer in its stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json): theme-invariant scales under core.* and every theme-switching name — the :root hue scales and the class-scoped semantics (--background-base-*, --text-*, --header-*, --border-*, --badge-*, --button-*, --input-*) — emitted under both light.* (.theme-light) and dark.* (.theme-darker) so each theme resolves its own value. Both classes paint signed out — the app surfaces carry .theme-dark.theme-darker while the marketing chrome inside them sits under .theme-light — so both resolutions are painted evidence. hsl()/rgba()/oklab() colour vars are normalised to hex. Measured roles alias to the declared values where they match.
